assumptions.choice: Submit orders toward the stated net target position rather than maintain separately tracked long and short legs.
assumptions.reason: A single Backtrader position in one asset is netted; the specification explicitly defines units_net as the actual target position.

assumptions.choice: For hedge updates, validity means the direction-specific MACD trend filter plus the ATR/close volatility filter; the crossover is treated as the one-bar entry trigger.
assumptions.reason: A CrossOver value is event-based and does not remain positive or negative after the crossing bar.
